address: 4238 Magazine St., New Orleans, LA, 70115, USA
bio: Occupying a prime corner spot on hip Magazine Street, this restaurant charms from its yellow facade and green doors to its quaint interiors. Its elegant yet unpretentious attitude extends to the kitchen, where delicious offerings include a bright and refreshing heirloom tomato salad with salsa verde and bottarga and creative blue crab beignets, a signature from Chef/owner Justin Devillier. Other must-try dishes include the tender paneed rabbit and parmesan-licked grits with wilted local greens, turnip purée and a Robert sauce....
